You record a screen demo.
And suddenly, you’re stuck looking for a quick way to convert or compress a video — without installing heavy software or creating an account.
That’s the problem I wanted to solve.
Why Conversion and Compression Matter
In daily design and development work, video files are everywhere:
Screen recordings for demos
Short clips for product previews
Walkthrough videos for clients or teammates
But large video files slow everything down:
Uploads take longer
Sharing becomes annoying
Some platforms reject the file altogether
Often, all you need is:
A different format
A smaller file size
A version that’s easier to send
Not a full editing suite.
What the QuickZap Video Converter Focuses On
The QuickZap Video Converter is built around two core actions:
Video Conversion


Video Compression



No timelines.
Just upload → convert or compress → download.
Designed to Be Lightweight
The goal wasn’t to compete with professional video tools.
Browser-based
No login required
Clean interface
Fast and straightforward
It’s a tool you use for a minute — and then move on with your work.
Part of the QuickZap Toolbox
This video tool is one of many small utilities inside QuickZap — a growing collection of focused tools for designers and developers.
Each tool exists for one reason:
Make repetitive, everyday tasks easier.
No bloated features.
Try It
The Video Converter & Compressor is live on QuickZap:
https://www.quickzap.xyz/video-convert
Free to use, directly in your browser.
If you have suggestions for other tools that could save time in your daily work, I’d love to hear them.

「人の目で確認すれば大丈夫」という幻想


先月、僕のチームで起きた出来事です。
ChatGPTでAPIコードを生成して、いつものように手動でテストしていました。「AIが作ったコードでも、最後は人がチェックすれば問題ない」そう思っていたんです。
ところが、ある日突然、手動テストが完全に破綻しました。

エンドポイントが30分で5個増える
リクエスト構造が1時間で3回変わる
影響範囲の確認だけで半日潰れる
